sections.title: Section 1: Strategic Shifts (10 Questions)
questions: How has the company’s stated mission or long-term vision changed over the past five years?
Has the company expanded into new business segments or industries? Provide evidence.
Has the company discontinued any major product lines or services? Explain why.
How has the company’s revenue diversification (by product, service, or geography) changed?
Have there been changes in the company's branding or positioning in the market?
How have acquisitions or divestitures affected the company’s strategic direction?
Has the company entered or exited international markets? If so, what reasons were given?
Have there been shifts in capital allocation priorities, such as investing more in R&D versus acquisitions?
Has the company adopted new business models (e.g., subscription-based vs. one-time sales)?
How has the company’s approach to digital transformation evolved?

sections.title: Section 2: Competitive Landscape (10 Questions)
questions: How has the company’s identification of key competitors changed?
Have there been shifts in the company's market share, based on disclosures?
Have technological advancements by competitors forced the company to adapt its strategy?
Has the company changed its stance on pricing strategy relative to competitors?
How has the company responded to new market entrants in its industry?
Have there been shifts in the company’s industry ranking or recognition?
Have changes in customer demand influenced the company’s competitive strategy?
How has the company adjusted to supply chain disruptions affecting its industry?
Have regulatory changes benefited or harmed the company’s competitive position?
Has the company adopted partnerships or joint ventures to compete more effectively?

sections.title: Section 3: Risk Factors & Legal Considerations (10 Questions)
questions: What new risks have been introduced in recent years that were not present before?
Have any previously listed risks been removed? If so, why?
Has the company disclosed any material cybersecurity risks over time?
How have external risks such as geopolitical tensions affected the company?
Have there been significant changes in litigation or regulatory scrutiny?
Has the company adjusted its risk mitigation strategies in response to external threats?
Have there been any notable changes in environmental, social, and governance (ESG) risks?
Has the company faced new legal challenges related to antitrust concerns?
How has the company’s disclosure on supply chain risks evolved?
What changes have been made to the company’s approach to intellectual property protection?

sections.title: Section 4: Management & Governance (10 Questions)
questions: Have there been significant changes in the executive leadership team?
Have there been changes in the board of directors’ composition or governance policies?
Have the CEO’s stated priorities changed in their annual letters to shareholders?
Has the company introduced any corporate restructuring or reorganization initiatives?
Have changes in executive compensation structures affected strategic decision-making?
Have there been major shifts in shareholder activism or governance disputes?
How have changes in leadership impacted the company’s culture and workforce?
Has the company altered its shareholder engagement strategies?
Have there been any notable changes in insider ownership and executive stock sales?
Has the company adopted new governance frameworks in response to regulatory changes?

sections.title: Section 5: Operations & Supply Chain (10 Questions)
questions: How has the company’s supply chain strategy evolved in response to external disruptions?
Has the company moved toward greater vertical integration? Provide examples.
Have there been changes in key suppliers or sourcing strategies?
How has the company responded to inflationary pressures on raw materials or logistics?
Have there been operational efficiency initiatives that impacted margins?
Have production facilities been expanded, closed, or relocated?
Has automation played a larger role in the company’s operations over time?
Have changes in supplier relationships led to cost savings or new risks?
How has the company’s crisis management approach evolved over time?
Has the company responded to sustainability concerns in its supply chain?

sections.title: Section 6: ESG & Corporate Responsibility (10 Questions)
questions: How has the company’s ESG reporting evolved over time?
Has the company introduced new sustainability initiatives or targets?
How has the company’s stance on climate-related risks changed?
Has the company adopted any new diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) policies?
Have philanthropic efforts or corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives changed?
Has the company faced controversies related to ESG practices?
Have investor or regulatory pressures influenced ESG disclosures?
How has the company’s approach to ethical sourcing evolved?
Has the company implemented or adjusted carbon neutrality goals?
Have changes in ESG priorities impacted investor sentiment toward the company?

sections.title: Section 7: Customer & Market Trends (10 Questions)
questions: How have customer preferences influenced product development?
Has the company changed its target customer base?
Have changes in consumer behavior affected the company’s marketing strategy?
Has the company responded to shifts in digital commerce trends?
How has the company adjusted pricing strategies in response to inflation or recession concerns?
Have there been significant changes in customer loyalty or churn rates?
How has customer service strategy evolved over time?
Has the company introduced new sales channels?
Have changes in regulatory requirements affected customer interactions?
Has the company responded to shifts in generational consumer preferences?

sections.title: Section 8: Intellectual Property & Innovation (10 Questions)
questions: How has the company’s R&D investment changed over time?
Has the company introduced significant patents or proprietary technology?
Have there been notable changes in the company's innovation strategy?
Has the company acquired any intellectual property through M&A?
Have partnerships with research institutions or universities increased?
Has the company disclosed concerns about patent expirations?
Have there been shifts in technology adoption within the company?
Has the company’s innovation approach shifted due to competition?
How has AI or automation influenced the company’s R&D focus?
Has the company introduced any open-source or collaborative innovation initiatives?

sections.title: Section 9: Human Capital & Workforce Trends (10 Questions)
questions: How has the company’s total workforce size changed over time?
Have shifts in remote work policies affected operational strategies?
Has the company faced major unionization efforts?
Have employee turnover rates increased or decreased?
Has there been a shift in the company’s talent acquisition strategy?
How has employee training and development evolved?
Have compensation structures changed significantly?
Has the company adjusted benefits or workplace culture initiatives?
How has the company responded to labor market shortages?
Have AI or automation trends influenced workforce planning?

sections.title: Section 10: Investor Relations & Financial Disclosures (10 Questions)
questions: How has the company’s investor communication strategy evolved?
Has the company changed how it presents financial metrics over time?
Have share buyback programs or dividend policies changed?
Has the company’s credit rating changed?
Have institutional ownership levels changed significantly?
Has the company adopted a different approach to forward guidance?
Have activist investors influenced strategic changes?
How has the company’s disclosure on intangible assets evolved?
Have there been material changes in accounting policies?
How has the company responded to changes in market sentiment?
